title:
A linter auto-fixed the repo.
52,000 lines changed.
`git blame` now says you wrote it all.
subtitle: Someone turned on Prettier with `tabWidth: 4` instead of `2`. Every single file in the repository was touched, turning every existing pull request into an irreconcilable conflict warzone.
logs: > committing with message: 'chore: minor styling fixes'.
> running `git blame` on auth system from 2015...
> author for security logic: 'You (2 minutes ago)'.
> CEO pings you: 'Why did you break authentication in 2015?'
> 14 teammates unable to merge feature branches.
> team lead announces immediate moratorium on all formatting.
footnote: Error code: `PRETTIER-APOCALYPSE-404` · Files formatted: 1,482 · Blame shifted: Exclusively to you
